events.summaryZh: 戴上 VR 头显进入阿波罗11号任务，从宇航员训练、火箭发射一路探索到月球表面。 10岁起且身高至少130cm；10–15岁须成人陪同，其他未成年人按官网要求预签免责书 提前15分钟到场签免责书；不能带婴儿或推车。主办方禁止心脏病或癫痫者参加，不建议孕期、晕动、恐高或幽闭者参加。无字幕且需弯腰；电动轮椅须手动模式，手杖使用者须换用现场轮椅。
events.summaryEn: Step into the Apollo 11 mission in virtual reality, exploring astronaut training, rocket launch and the lunar surface together. Ages 10+ and at least 130cm; ages 10–15 need an adult, and other unaccompanied minors need the required pre-signed waiver Arrive 15 minutes early for the waiver; no babies or strollers. The organiser excludes heart conditions or epilepsy and advises against pregnancy, motion sickness, vertigo or claustrophobia. No subtitles; bending is required. Power wheelchairs need manual mode, and cane users must use onsite wheelchairs.
